issues: mipmap-*/ic_launcher_foreground.png are saved in RGB mode (no alpha channel). Adaptive icons expect the foreground layer to have transparency so the background color (#000000) shows through parallax/zoom animations and under non-circular launcher masks (squircle, teardrop). With RGB the full 108dp foreground is an opaque black square, which hides the background layer and may show black square edges during the parallax zoom on some launchers. Visually it still looks correct inside a circular mask (content is on black anyway), so this is cosmetic — but best practice is to re-export the PNGs as RGBA with the surrounding area transparent. Also the 72dp safe-zone inside the 108dp canvas should contain the full logo; verify the hands+steering wheel are centered within the inner 72dp circle so launcher masks don't clip the golden hands.

critical_code_review_comments: ✅ Icon migration clean: no stale @drawable/ic_launcher_foreground anywhere (grep across *.xml/*.kt/*.java). mipmap-anydpi-v26/ic_launcher.xml and ic_launcher_round.xml both point to @mipmap/ic_launcher_foreground. ic_launcher_foreground.png is only in mipmap-* folders (no drawable copy) → no R.* name conflict (resource type is 'mipmap' in all 5 density qualifiers).
✅ PNG dimensions correct per density for a 108dp adaptive-icon canvas: 108 (mdpi 1x), 162 (hdpi 1.5x), 216 (xhdpi 2x), 324 (xxhdpi 3x), 432 (xxxhdpi 4x).

✅ FloatingBubble.BubbleView Kotlin init order is safe. Even though `logo`, `logoRect`, `bitmapPaint` are declared below the `onDraw` method, they are val properties with simple initializers (BitmapFactory.decodeResource wrapped in runCatching, Rect(), Paint()); properties are initialized in source order before the constructor completes, well before the first invalidate() triggers onDraw. kotlinc 1.9.22 EXIT 0 confirms. The null-safety on `bmp = logo` + runCatching ensures a missing asset gracefully falls back to drawing the letter 'V'.
✅ Rect import correctly uses android.graphics.Rect at top of file (also used for visibleRect() return type). ImageView import correctly uses android.widget.ImageView in OfferOverlay.

✅ OfferOverlay baseline-aligned row: isBaselineAligned=true and ImageView baselineAlignBottom=true → the 22dp logo aligns to the bottom of the digit baseline rather than the TextView baseline (ImageView has no 'baseline' by default). This matches typical visual expectation (logo bottom-aligned with number bottom) and is the correct pattern.

✅ Static kotlinc 1.9.22 compile EXIT 0 against android-34 with a stub R and stub ResourcesCompat on FloatingBubble.kt + OfferOverlay.kt and all same-package deps. Produced .class files for all expected classes/inner classes.
✅ Detection pipeline (RideParser, AcceptanceTracker, ScreenOcr, RideAccessibilityService.handleScreen) NOT modified — only branding/visual code touched. Iter7's 40/40 JVM test suite remains valid.

⚠ MINOR: mipmap-*/ic_launcher_foreground.png is encoded as RGB (3 channels). Adaptive icon foreground should ideally be RGBA so the background layer can show through parallax and non-circular masks. Visual impact is cosmetic because the inner artwork is already on #000000; worst case is slight square-edge artifacts in launcher zoom animation.
⚠ MINOR: FloatingBubble.kt:29 KDoc still references 'Drivee tourne' — update to 'VTC Copilot' for consistency. Comment only, no behavior impact.
